book.name: Mateas
book.title: Khoes khabar djaise Mateas liekhies hai

content: Jiesoe Kriest ke baap-daada log ke naam
Ie sab naam Jiesoe Kriest ke baap-daada log ke hai. Oe Daawied aur Aabraaham ke aulaad hai.

content.text: Jaakob Joeda aur okar bhaai log ke baap raha.
Joeda Peres aur Serah ke baap raha aur oelogke maai Taamar raha.
Peres Hesron ke baap raha aur Hesron Aaram ke baap raha.
Aamienaadab Nahson ke baap raha. Nahson ke beta Saalmon raha.
Saalmon Boas ke baap raha djaun ke maai Raahab raha.
Boas Obed ke baap raha aur okar maai Roet raha.
Jesai raadja Daawied ke baap raha.
Daawied Saalomo ke baap raha aur Saalomo ke maai Oeria ke aurat raha.
Josia Jekonia ke aur okar bhaai ke baap raha oe samai djab Israel ke djaatie log Baabielonia ke des me djabar-djastie se ledjaawal gail raha.
Ekare baad Jekonia ke beta Sealtiejel paida bhail.
Josaf Maria ke aadmie raha, aur Maria Jiesoe ke maai raha. Jiesoe bhie Kriest

content: Aabraaham se Daawied talak tjauda pierahie hai. Aur bhie tjauda pierahie hai Daawied se leike djab talak djanta ke Baabielonia des me djaai ke paral. Aur djab se oesab Baabielonia se lautke aail Kriest ke djanam talak bhie tjauda palwaar hai.
Ab ham bataab Jiesoe Kriest ke djanam kaise bhail. Maria ke tjhekaai Josaf se hoi gail raha. Aur oesabke biaah howe se pahiele aise bhail kie Maria ke Pawietr Aatma dwaara larka howat.
Maria ke hone waala patie ek bhala aadmie raha aur oe na maangat raha kie Maria ke saram pahoetje. Ohie se oe aapan man me sotjies Maria ke biena haltjal matjaawe tjhor dewe ke.

Bakie djab oe aisan bietjaar karat raha tab oe ekgo sapana me dekhies kie ek Parmeswar ke parie okar paas aail aur bolies: „He Josaf, Daawied ke aulaad, toe na sotj kar Maria se biaah kare ke. Oe Larka to Pawietr Aatma ke dwaara paida hoi.
Maria ke ek beta hoi aur toe okar naam Jiesoe dharaihe. Oe aapan djaatie ke paap me se batjaaiga.
Ie sab hoiga djeme Parmeswar ke baat poera howe djaun oe dher dien pahiele aapan sanesia Jasaaja ke dwaara djanaais raha. Oe ose bolies raha:

content.text: ‘Soen, kania ke ek beta paida hoiga. Aur okar naam Emaanoewel rahiega.
Ie naam ke matlab hai: Parmeswar hamlogke saath hai.’ ”

content: Djab Josaf djaag gail tab oe karies djaise Prabhoe ke parie ose bolies raha. Oe Maria ke aapan ghare legail.
Bakie oe okar saath na soetal djab talak okar beta na paida bhail. Aur oe Larka ke naam Jiesoe dharaais.

footnotes.text: ‘Kriest’ ke matlab hai ‘Parmeswar ke waada karal Raadja.’
